title: Akhri azan sunli
body:
Akhri azan sunli
Akhri azan to sunli, amaa achi meri amaa
<<MINI>>
Sine se lagalo marne ki riza do (Amma achi meri amma) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay Amma phuphi jaan ke do laal sidhare darya ka kanare tum apne jawan laal ko shabbir pe waro Amma achi meri amma
<<MINI>>
Sine se lagalo marne ki riza do (Amma achi meri amma)x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Sehra tera bete ke muqadar me nahi tha ab wakht ye aya poshak -e-shahani ko kafan mera banalo Amma achi meri amma
<<MINI>>
Sine se lagalo marne ki riza do (Amma achi meri amma)x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo dekho su-e-dashte bala madar-e-muztar gere he sitam gar kya bap ki nusrat na karu mujko bata do Amma achi meri amma
<<MINI>>
Sine se lagalo marne ki riza do (Amma achi meri amma)x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Mana ke nahi bete ki furqat koyi aasan pan kya karu amma yeh sabre ki manzil hai zara dil ko sambhala lo Amma achi meri amma
<<MINI>>
Sine se lagalo marne ki riza do (Amma achi meri amma)x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Khuch der me ye laal bhi keh layenga lasha hai ek tamana bimar -e madina ko madine se bula lo Amma achi meri amma
<<MINI>>
Sine se lagalo marne ki riza do (Amma achi meri amma) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya tumko gawara hai ke zindaa rahe beta aur katl ho baba me is liye kehta hu na jine ki saza do Amma achi meri amma
<<MINI>>
Sine se lagalo marne ki riza do (Amma achi meri amma)x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Tarpongi shab -o- roz meri yaad de me har dam kerte huwe matam ik baar muje apne kaleje se laga lo Amma achi meri amma
<<MINI>>
Sine se lagalo marne ki riza do (Amma achi meri amma) x2
